quests.title: Darwin's Beetles
quests.summary: Collect a beetle for the library in Darwin's old school, the way young Charles would have.

steps.text: Ask the head gardener in the Quarry where the beetles hide.
Catch a Squibbet and show it to the librarian.

quests.reward: Darwin's Hand Lens (a charm that makes snares likelier) and standing in England.

quests.title: Iron for the Bridge
quests.summary: A bracket under the Iron Bridge has cracked. Get a new one cast the old way, at Coalbrookdale.

steps.text: Fetch the old wooden pattern from the engineer at Ditherington Flax Mill in Shrewsbury.
Beat the apprentice at Darby's Old Furnace, then have the furnace master cast the bracket.
Take the new casting to the toll keeper at the Iron Bridge.

quests.reward: A Pigling, the Coalbrookdale Ingot (hearth charm) and standing in England.

quests.title: The Wenlock Olympian Games
quests.summary: Compete in the creature pentathlon at the games that inspired the modern Olympics.

steps.text: Learn about the Games from the curator at Much Wenlock Museum.
Win all four events on the Linden Field, back to back.

quests.reward: The Wenlock Medal (a speed charm) and standing in England.

quests.title: Shrews or Shrows?
quests.summary: Settle how to say Shrewsbury, by asking two impartial locals out in the county.

steps.text: Ask the walker on top of the Wrekin.
Ask the pony warden on the Long Mynd.
Report back to the pair arguing on High Street.

quests.reward: Three Shrewsbury Cakes and standing in England.
